stop.title: Stop streaming to {count} places?
stop.body: Viewers will see the stream end. You can't restart this broadcast. Starting again creates a new one.
brand.name: raelstream
home.title: Start a service
home.noBroadcast: Starting a service only opens preparation. Nothing is sent anywhere until you choose to.
home.createFailed: The service could not be created. Try again.
prep.uplink.title: How fast is the internet here?
prep.dest.title: Where is this service going?
prep.uplink.body: Measures how fast this church connection can upload, then suggests 720p or 1080p. Run it before the service, when nobody is streaming or uploading.
prep.uplink.failed: The test could not finish. Check the internet connection and try again.
prep.uplink.notWhileSending: The test is not available while sending: it would take upload speed from the programme.
prep.uplink.notMeasured: Upload not measured. Choose 720p unless you know the connection is fast.
prep.uplink.dataUse: Each test uploads up to 40 MB.
prep.uplink.offer.reliable_hd: Good for 720p. 1080p needs at least 12 Mb/s.
prep.uplink.offer.insufficient: Slower than 720p needs (7 Mb/s). Viewers may see stalls; consider a wired connection or a different network.
prep.uplink.aboveOffer: This is more than the measured upload supports. Viewers may see stalls or the platform may drop the stream.
prep.dest.body: Tick where this service goes. Facebook needs a new stream key each week: paste it here. Keys are locked on the server and never shown again.
prep.dest.fbKey: Facebook stream key for this service
prep.dest.fbKeyNeeded: Facebook key needed for this service
prep.dest.fbKeyHelp: Copy it from Facebook Live Producer (Streaming software → Stream key), then paste it here.
prep.dest.sameAsLast: This looks like last week's key. Facebook may have issued a new one: check Live Producer.
prep.dest.keyFailed: The key could not be saved. Try again.
prep.dest.noKey: No stream key yet. The owner adds it in Settings → Destinations.
prep.dest.ytManual: YouTube waits for you: when sending starts, click Go Live in YouTube Live Control Room.
prep.dest.fbManual: Facebook waits for you: when sending starts, click Go live in Live Producer.
prep.dest.autoPublic: {platform} goes public as soon as sending starts.
prep.left.destKey: Before going live, paste Facebook's key for this service (or untick Facebook).
devices.title: Connect the camera
devices.cameraHint: The phone on the production Wi-Fi
devices.waitingForStart: Waiting for the phone to start its camera
devices.profileNote: Upload speed hasn't been measured yet. 720p needs less from the laptop and the internet.
devices.framingNote: Fit keeps the whole camera picture, with black bars if the phone is not landscape. Fill crops the edges instead. The programme stays 16:9 either way.
devices.lowFps: The phone is sending {fps} fps. Phones lower the frame rate in dim light: more light on the subject usually brings it back to 30.
pair.instructions: Connect the phone to {ssid} first, then scan this code with its camera app.
pair.qrAlt: Pairing code for the camera phone
pending.compare: Check the phone shows the same words, then let it in.
pending.phoneAway: The phone isn't connected right now.
directFail.title: Camera can't reach this laptop directly
directFail.body: Both devices must be on {ssid}, the laptop should be plugged into the same router, and the router must allow devices to see each other. Raelstream doesn't send camera video through the internet as a fallback.
audio.title: Is the mixer coming through?
audio.deviceLost: The USB audio interface disconnected. The programme is silent. Plug it back in and choose it again.
audio.phoneWaiting: Waiting for the phone. If it asks, tap Allow to share its microphone.
audio.phone.denied: The phone blocked its microphone. On the phone, allow microphone access for this page, then choose phone sound again.
audio.phone.unavailable: The phone has no microphone it can share.
audio.phone.error: The phone could not open its microphone. Check that no other app is using it, then choose phone sound again.
audio.phoneNote: Phone sound travels with the picture over Wi-Fi. Use the mixer when you can. If the phone link drops, the programme is silent until it reconnects: nothing switches to another microphone by itself.
audio.phoneLost: The phone stopped sending sound. The programme is silent until the phone reconnects, or choose another input.
audio.captureError: The audio input couldn't be opened. Check the browser allowed microphone access.
audio.processingOn: The browser kept this processing on: {list}. Music may sound different.
audio.oneChannel: The browser is giving us one channel from this device, so stereo options are off.
audio.aim: Aim for green, just below the amber line.
audio.clipped: Clipped {n} times. Turn the mixer send down a little.
audio.channelTest: To check the routing, play something into Input 1 only and watch which meter moves.
audio.compressorDesc: Evens out loud and quiet speakers
audio.listenDesc: Plays the programme sound on this laptop, after the lip-sync delay. Use headphones: laptop speakers feed back into the microphone and howl.
audio.silent: Mixer audio has been silent for 15 seconds.
audio.silentIntentional: This is intentional (no warning for 5 min)
sync.status.recheck: Recheck recommended: the camera, audio input, routing, profile or delay changed
sync.tool.how: Record a test clip of the programme while someone claps in front of the camera, close to a microphone that feeds the mixer. Then step to the frame where the hands meet.
sync.tool.recording: Recording the programme: clap now. {s} s left.
sync.tool.unsupported: This browser cannot record the programme. Use Chrome or Edge.
sync.tool.decodeFailed: The clip could not be read. Try recording it again.
sync.tool.waveLabel: Sound in the clip: red marks the detected clap, blue the frame you marked
sync.tool.markFrame: The hands meet in this frame
sync.tool.onset: Clap sound detected at {s} s (red line). Check it matches the clap you heard.
sync.tool.noOnset: No clear clap sound was found. Clap louder, closer to a mixer microphone, after a moment of quiet.
sync.tool.result: The sound is {offset} ms after the picture (negative: before). Suggested audio delay: {suggested} ms.
sync.tool.audioLate: Audio is arriving later than video. Audio delay cannot fix this configuration.
sync.tool.recheckAfterApply: After changing the delay, record a new clip to confirm, then save.
sync.title: Lip-sync
sync.rule: Increase audio delay when sound happens before the matching movement.
sync.method: Check it with a clap on camera, near a microphone that feeds the mixer. The clip-review tool comes in a later build.
rundown.title: What goes on screen, in order?
rundown.name: Name
rundown.detailHelp: Announcements or a scripture passage. {n} characters left.
rundown.textTooLong: Text too long for the card. Shorten it or split it into two cards.
rundown.image: Image file (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB)
rundown.imageNotLoaded: No image yet. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP (up to 10 MB).
rundown.imageUploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded. Check the connection and try again.
rundown.fits: Lines longer than {n} characters get shortened on air. This one fits.
rundown.tooLong: Longer than {n} characters. It will be shortened on air.
rundown.empty: Add the lower thirds, text cards and images for this service.
rundown.footnote: {n} items. You can still edit and reorder during the service.
go.title: Start streaming?
go.publicWarning: Viewers may see this as soon as video arrives.
go.meta: Programme {profile}. Mixer audio and the current scene go out as they are now.
dest.noneConfigured: No destinations set up yet. The owner adds them on the server (see the WP0 runbook).
dest.receiving: Receiving · publish it on the platform
dest.receivingYoutube: Receiving · publish it in YouTube Studio
dest.stopped: Sending stopped · check the platform ended
go.record: Record a private copy for the owner (about {gb} GB per hour, kept 30 days)
rec.title: Private recording
rec.body: What viewers saw, including any slate, in 10-minute files. Deleted automatically after 30 days.
go.noKey: No stream key for this service: paste it in Preparation → Destinations.
dest.fixKeyPrompt: Paste Facebook's current stream key for this service
dest.fail.url: Stopped · this server address isn't allowed
banner.slateTitle: Viewers are seeing the "We'll be right back" slate
banner.slateBody: The programme stopped reaching the server. Check this laptop's internet. Publishing ends when the countdown runs out unless the studio reconnects.
banner.partialBody: {bad} stopped. Use Retry next to it. The other destination is not affected.
banner.endedBody: Sending has stopped. Check each platform shows the broadcast as ended. Starting again creates a new service.
live.needs.lower_third: Camera + lower third needs a lower third in the rundown (Preparation → Rundown).
live.needs.text: Text card needs a text card in the rundown (Preparation → Rundown).
health.inferred: Inferred from the video encoder, not a CPU reading
cam.invalidTitle: This code is no longer valid
cam.invalidBody: Ask the studio for a new one, then scan it again.
cam.videoOnly: This phone will send video only. Sound comes from the church mixer.
cam.joinFailed: Couldn't join. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.
cam.waitingBody: Show the studio these words so they can let this phone in.
cam.permissionExplain: Tap Start camera and allow camera access. The microphone is not used.
cam.err.permission: Camera permission was blocked. Tap the lock icon in the address bar, then Permissions, then Camera, then Allow. Then tap Try again.
cam.err.inUse: The camera is being used by another app. Close other camera apps and try again.
cam.err.notFound: No camera was found on this phone.
cam.err.unsupported: This browser couldn't start the camera. Use Chrome on this phone.
cam.q.reduced: Reduced quality · move closer to the router
cam.q.unstable: Unstable · move closer to the router
cam.audio.starting: The studio wants this phone's sound: tap Allow
cam.audio.denied: Microphone blocked: the studio gets no sound from this phone
cam.audio.unavailable: No microphone found on this phone
cam.audio.error: The microphone stopped: the studio gets no sound from this phone
cam.keepOpen: Keep this screen open. Locking the phone stops the camera.
cam.keepOpenNoLock: Keep this page open and the screen unlocked. This phone may turn the screen off by itself.
cam.rejectedTitle: The studio didn't let this phone in
cam.endedBody: The camera is off. Ask the studio for a new code to join again.
signin.title: Sign in to the studio
signin.codeHelp: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for raelstream.
signin.recoveryHelp: Type one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up this account. Each code works once.
signin.failed: That didn't work. Check the details and try again.
home.noPresets: No saved services yet. Add one below so the rundown and audio settings are ready each week.
invite.title: Join the studio team
invite.body: {name} invited you to operate the raelstream studio.
invite.name: Your name
invite.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
invite.enrolBody: Scan this code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar), or type the key below.
invite.recoveryBody: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Write them down or save them now. They will not be shown again.
invite.codeFailed: That code didn't work. Ask the owner for a new invite if this keeps happening.
invite.invalidTitle: This invite link is no longer valid
invite.invalidBody: Invite links work once and expire after 3 days. Ask the owner for a new one.
settings.title: People
destEdit.title: Destinations
destEdit.body: Where services can be sent. Stream keys are locked on the server as soon as you paste them: nobody can read them back, only replace them.
destEdit.perEvent: New key each service (pasted in Preparation)
destEdit.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? Its stream key is deleted.
destEdit.label: Name
destEdit.keyKeep: Keep the saved key (paste to replace it)
destEdit.keyHelp: Copy it from the platform, then Paste. It is locked on the server straight away.
destEdit.perEventHelp: The operator pastes this service's key in Preparation → Destinations. It is deleted when the service ends.
destEdit.autoHelpYt: In YouTube Live Control Room, “Auto-start” makes the stream public as soon as video arrives. Without it, someone clicks Go Live there.
destEdit.autoHelpFb: In Facebook Live Producer, “Go live” makes it public; the streaming-software preview waits until someone clicks Go live.
destEdit.eventReference: Note (optional, e.g. which event or page)
theme.title: Church look on air
theme.body: How the church appears to viewers: logo, colours, font and the holding image. It applies to every service. The studio's own screens stay neutral.
theme.churchName: Church name (shown on the holding slate)
theme.logoHelp: A PNG with a transparent background looks best. It is checked and cleaned on the server before use.
theme.contrastOk: White text on the main colour: contrast {ratio}:1, easy to read.
theme.contrastLow: White text on the main colour: contrast {ratio}:1. It needs at least 4.5:1, so choose a darker main colour.
theme.holdingHelp: Shown full screen instead of the “We'll be right back” slate.
settings.inviteBody: Create a one-time link and send it to the volunteer privately. It works once and expires after 3 days.
lease.title: Viewing only: {who} is running the studio
lease.anotherTab: another tab or device signed in as you
lease.body: This tab can't change anything. Take over only if the other studio is closed or stuck.
lease.askOwner: This tab can't change anything. Only the owner can take over from someone else, so ask them if the other studio is stuck.
lease.confirmBody: The studio used by {who} stops sending straight away. Viewers see the "We'll be right back" slate for a few seconds while this tab takes over, and the camera phone reconnects here.
audio.accessNeeded: Allow microphone access so the studio can list your audio inputs (the mixer interface, the laptop microphone, and so on).
audio.accessDenied: The browser blocked microphone access. Click the padlock next to the address, set Microphone to Allow, then try again. On a managed work laptop, IT may have blocked it.
audio.noInputs: No audio inputs were found. Plug in the audio interface, then try again.
